body:
> Do you have something planned to lower the number of search calls in case of multiple remove?

This would be easily implemented, we can enhance the API of `removeWidget()` to accept an Array of widgets instances and compute the SearchParameters for the next search before triggering it.

> Do you have an idea for the dynamic addWidget?

I need to do the PoC, but from the code of InstantSearch.js we can track if the search is already started and [here](https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/blob/develop/src/lib/InstantSearch.js#L84-L91) call [this same function](https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/blob/develop/src/lib/InstantSearch.js#L120-L123) to update the SearchParameters before triggering a new search 👍
